rows.commentary: 31.2: Nathan Lyon loops one up outside off, and MJ Ackerman can only mistime the drive straight back to the bowler.
31.3: Nathan Lyon pulls back his length and offers width outside off, allowing MJ Ackerman to comfortably leave it through to the keeper.
31.4: MJ Ackerman charges down the track to Nathan Lyon, gets completely beaten by the flight and dip, and Alex Carey whips off the bails to end a magnificent 95.
31.5: Nathan Lyon fires it flat on off stump, and David Bedingham pushes the ball right back down the pitch.
31.6: David Bedingham lets a drifting leg-side delivery pass while Alex Carey flashes the bails off, though replays quickly confirm the batsman's foot is safely anchored inside the crease.
32.1: Pat Cummins steams in at 140ks on a good length outside off, meeting a solid defensive stroke from Aiden Markram.
32.2: Pat Cummins delivers a 134ks full ball outside off, which Aiden Markram drills off the bottom half toward the diving mid-off fielder.
32.3: Pat Cummins targets just outside off at 140ks, and Aiden Markram calmly blocks the ball right beneath his nose.
32.4: Pat Cummins sends down a 139ks full delivery veering into off, drilled straight back off the cue end before Cummins sharply halts it in his follow-through.
32.5: Pat Cummins clocks 141ks on a length outside the off stump, watched carefully by Aiden Markram as it sails through to the keeper.
32.6: Pat Cummins hits a 139ks good length around off, prompting Aiden Markram to hop back and punch it cleanly to Head at short extra cover.
33.1: Josh Hazlewood lands one on a good length just outside off, and David Bedingham steps back to dead-bat it into the off-side.
33.2: Hazlewood probes away at one hundred and thirty-two kph, inducing a soft outside edge from Bedingham that dies harmlessly into the turf before gully.
33.3: Hazlewood slides it fuller at one hundred and thirty-five kph, inviting a drive from Bedingham that crashes straight into the palms of mid-off.
33.4: Hazlewood drops back to a length at one hundred and thirty-one kph, and Bedingham meets it with deadened wrists and a defensive block.
33.5: Hazlewood offers width and pace at one hundred and thirty-eight kph, allowing Bedingham to open the face and scorch a pristine cover drive to the rope.
33.6: Hazlewood completes the over at one hundred and thirty-one kph, angling a full delivery in to be securely smothered on the front foot by Bedingham.
43.6: Lyon tosses it up on the pads and Bedingham flicks it safely to short fine.
44.1: Hazlewood delivers a back-of-a-length ball at 133kph just outside off, defended firmly from the crease.
44.2: Hazlewood pitches it up on middle and Markram punches it straight to mid-on.
44.3: Hazlewood hits a good length on middle at 128kph, clipped away by Markram to midwicket.
44.4: Hazlewood digs it short and Markram skies a pull, leaving Starc to sprint from fine leg, dive low, and clutch a brilliant two-handed catch near the rope.
44.5: Hazlewood sends down a 134kph hard-length delivery around off, blocked from the crease by Bavuma.
44.6: Hazlewood tests Bavuma again, who stands solid and blocks firmly from the crease.
45.1: Lyon floats it up full, allowing Bedingham to knock it down to long-on.
45.2: Lyon flights one with gorgeous drift that beats Bavuma's outside edge and clips the off stump, sparking a pumped celebration from the bowler.
45.3: Lyon tosses it up around off and Breetzke knocks it out into the off-side.
45.4: Lyon comes round the wicket, drifting it away outside off for Bedingham to push forward and knock to cover.
45.5: Lyon floats it quite full outside off, and Bedingham drives crisply but straight to mid-off.
45.6: Nathan Lyon bowls a crisp delivery to David Bedingham, who swings the bat to a soft leading edge that rolls down the pitch, leaving no runs.
46.1: Josh Hazlewood delivers a good-length ball around off to Matthew Breetzke, who defends it from the crease with a clean shot.
46.2: Matthew Breetzke does not score off Josh Hazlewood.
52.5: Pat Cummins delivers a length ball to David Bedingham, who plants his front foot and defends the on-side shot.
52.6: Pat Cummins bowls a slanted length to David Bedingham, who tucks the ball into the midwicket for a single, closing the session with a spring in his step.
53.1: Cooper Connolly sends a flat off to David Bedingham, who punches the ball back to the bowler.
53.2: Cooper Connolly bowls a short ball to David Bedingham, who cuts it to the left of backward point.
53.3: Cooper Connolly delivers a full off to David Bedingham, who leans out to block the flighted delivery.
53.4: Cooper Connolly bowls a full leg stump to David Bedingham, who kneels down and sweeps it past the square‑leg fielder for a four.
53.5: Cooper Connolly sends a looped off to David Bedingham, who squeezes a drive to cover.
53.6: Cooper Connolly bowls a sliding delivery to David Bedingham, who flicks it to the left of Lyon at square leg for a single.
54.1: Mitchell Starc bowls a short off at 139 kph to David Bedingham, who stands tall and blocks with soft hands.
54.2: Mitchell Starc delivers a short off at 138 kph to David Bedingham, who hops and punches it to the left of cover.
54.3: Mitchell Starc bowls a good length around off at 144 kph to David Bedingham, who blocks it calmly from the back foot.
54.4: Mitchell Starc bowls a short ball at 145 kph to David Bedingham, who pulls it along the ground to deep square.
54.5: Starc hurls down a searing 147kph thunderbolt that slides past Rickelton's desperate, vain glance down the leg side.
54.6: Starc digs into a 143kph back of a length delivery, allowing Rickelton to force it firmly off the back foot out toward deep point.
55.1: Connolly loops up a full delivery outside off, and Rickelton meets it with a crisp drive heading wide of mid-off.
55.2: David Bedingham does not score off Cooper Connolly.
62.3: Pat Cummins steams in at 137 clicks, pitching full and slipping past the left-hander as Ryan Rickelton offers no stroke.
62.4: Pat Cummins digs it in short at 136ks well outside off, leaving Ryan Rickelton completely untroubled.
62.5: Pat Cummins extracts vicious extra bounce at 139ks, forcing a flinch from Ryan Rickelton as the ball whisks past his gloves on the pull.
62.6: Pat Cummins serves up a length ball that holds in the turf, and Ryan Rickelton lofts an aerial drive through extra cover with sweet timing for four.
63.1: Nathan Lyon flights this full on off stump, inducing Marco Jansen to prod across the line and dab into the leg-side.
63.2: Nathan Lyon catches a suspected inside edge off Marco Jansen's defensive prod, looping off the thigh pad just wide of the scrambling wicketkeeper.
63.3: Nathan Lyon drops this short on off, allowing Marco Jansen to punch it cleanly down to long-on for a single.
63.4: Nathan Lyon tosses it up and Ryan Rickelton simply pushes it straight back down the pitch.
63.5: Nathan Lyon slides a quicker one into Ryan Rickelton's back pad, but Australia wisely wave off the review as ball tracking confirms it misses off.
63.6: Nathan Lyon attacks the stumps with a full delivery, neatly tucked by Ryan Rickelton to the left of square leg.
64.1: Pat Cummins spears a 136ks bouncer down the leg-side, and Marco Jansen gracefully ducks beneath the trajectory.
64.2: Pat Cummins fires in another short delivery at 137ks, but Marco Jansen muscles a defiant pull over mid-wicket all the way to the rope.
64.3: Cummins drills a 135kph delivery short at the stumps, tempting Jansen into a pull that slips beneath the under edge.
64.4: Cummins digs another short ball steeply down the leg side, forcing Jansen to tuck himself safely beneath its trajectory.
64.5: Cummins unleashes a searing 142kph yorker on off stump, jammed away by Jansen into vacant turf at long-off for a comfortable couple.
64.6: Cummins fires in a 136kph bouncer targeted at the stumps, leaving Jansen entirely content to watch it sail through.
65.1: Lyon loops a short delivery on off stump, sharply punched by Rickelton straight toward the diving reach of Cummins at mid-off.
65.2: Lyon tosses one up invitingly on off, and Rickelton can only toe-end his drive straight back into the bowler's hands.
65.3: Lyon pushes a flatter delivery just outside off, clipped expertly by Rickelton toward the left of Cummins stationed at deep mid-on.
80.1: Mitchell Starc bowls a loose delivery to Ryan Rickelton, who threads it through the covers for a single, narrowly avoiding a boundary.
80.2: Starc launches a 145.5 kph ball from a short of length outside off, and Marco Jansen punches it to deep point with effortless power.
80.3: Mitchell Starc offers abundant width outside off with a loosener, and Ryan Rickelton swishes through the empty air in frustration.
80.4: Starc's full‑length, late‑swinging ball hits Rickelton on the back pad, sending him down the wicket for a clean lbw dismissal.
80.5: Starc bowls a back‑of‑length delivery to Simon Harmer, who clips it away but is struck on the thigh pad for a leg‑by‑e, one run.
80.6: Starc delivers a devastating yorker that swings in and crashes into Jansen's off stump, bowled.
Mitchell Starc has taken 2 wickets in this over.
81.1: Cummins sends a back‑of‑a‑length outside off to Harmer, who lets it pass.
81.2: Cummins bowls a length outside off to Harmer, who again leaves it.
81.3: Pat Cummins bowls a sharp inswinger that lands on the leg side, and Simon Harmer fails to control it, sending the ball past the leg glance.
81.4: Cummins attempts an away‑swinger that loses control, resulting in a wide.
81.4: Dot ball from Pat Cummins to Simon Harmer.
81.5: Cummins lands it on a good length outside off stump, and Harmer strides forward to dead-bat the delivery.
81.6: Cummins drifts it full and wide, allowing Harmer to watch it sail past in a lacklustre conclusion to the over.
82.1: Starc shatters the timber with vicious inswing to castle Coetzee for a golden duck, sealing his five-wicket haul and setting up a hat-trick chance.
82.2: Starc extracts sharp away-movement from a short-of-a-length delivery, completely squaring up Rabada on the defensive push.
82.3: Mitchell Starc bowls a full, fast delivery that swings away, nudging the ball past the outside edge and pinning Kagiso Rabada in front of leg stump for a clean‑up lbw dismissal.
13.4: Gerald Coetzee digs it in short, and Matt Renshaw watches it sail safely overhead by ducking beneath the trajectory.
13.5: Gerald Coetzee serves up a full and wide delivery, allowing Matt Renshaw to comfortably offer no stroke.
13.6: Gerald Coetzee hurries a 142.6kph delivery in from a short length, but Matt Renshaw easily evades it with a low duck.
14.1: Wiaan Mulder targets a full, wide channel at 129ks, inviting Travis Head to lean into a drive that picks out the mid-off fielder.
14.2: Wiaan Mulder pulls back the length at 126ks, inducing a mistimed punch from Travis Head straight toward mid-on.
14.3: Wiaan Mulder offers a sitting length outside off at 125ks, punishingly creamed past the diving cover fielder by Travis Head off the back foot.
14.4: Wiaan Mulder darts a 130ks delivery wide and short, cleanly cut away toward sweeper cover for a single.
14.5: Wiaan Mulder angles a 129ks delivery in that stays low, prompting Matt Renshaw to shoulder arms after covering his stump.
14.6: Wiaan Mulder unleashes a surprising 128ks yorker tailing sharply into the stumps, squeezed back to the bowler off the cue end by a reactive Matt Renshaw.
15.1: Gerald Coetzee rattles in a 147ks length ball on the stumps, smartly tucked away toward mid-wicket for a sharp single by Travis Head.
15.2: Gerald Coetzee probes a 143ks back-of-a-length delivery around off, gently tapped toward gully by the soft hands of Matt Renshaw.
15.3: Gerald Coetzee targets a 145ks short-of-length spot outside off, expertly dabbed toward backward point by Matt Renshaw with an open bat face.
15.4: Gerald Coetzee cranks it up to 143 clicks, hammering that short-of-a-length zone as Matt Renshaw safely drops it beneath his eyeline.
15.5: Gerald Coetzee fires down a scorching 147-kilometre-per-hour thunderbolt into the off-stump channel, which Matt Renshaw meets with wonderfully softened wrists.
15.6: Gerald Coetzee lands a 146-kilometre-per-hour delivery just fractionally fuller than a good length, prompting a comfortable forward prod straight down the pitch from Matt Renshaw.
16.1: Wiaan Mulder drifts wide of the crease to deliver a 132-kilometre-per-hour full ball outside off, stabbed away by Travis Head straight to Bavuma stationed at mid-off.
16.2: Wiaan Mulder serves up another full delivery at 126ks, cleanly struck by Travis Head before Bavuma flings himself to the right at mid-off to save the boundary.
16.3: Dot ball from Wiaan Mulder to Travis Head.
24.4: Marco Jansen pins a length delivery on the off-side while Cameron Green instantly rescinds a hasty call for a single.
24.5: Marco Jansen fires a full delivery toward off stump before Cameron Green drills it straight back to the bowler's hands.
24.6: Marco Jansen drifts a harmless length ball down the outside off channel, allowing Cameron Green to raise his bat and let it sail through.
25.1: Gerald Coetzee unleashes a searing 144kph thunderbolt on a good length that pitches on middle and rips past Matt Renshaw's outside edge.
25.2: Gerald Coetzee bangs in a 143kph delivery on the stumps, which Matt Renshaw clinically works square into the leg-side.
25.3: Gerald Coetzee pushes a 144kph good length ball onto the stumps as Cameron Green inside-edges a soft-handed block wide of square leg for a sharp single.
25.4: Gerald Coetzee charges in to deliver a 144kph short of length ball around leg stump that Matt Renshaw hops on to glance down toward fine leg.
25.5: Gerald Coetzee hits the deck hard with a viciously steep delivery that explodes off the surface to strike a fending Cameron Green on the gloves.
25.6: Gerald Coetzee strays down the leg-side with a rapid 148kph delivery that eludes both Cameron Green's attempted flick and the diving wicketkeeper's left glove to race away for four byes.
26.1: Marco Jansen attacks just outside off at 133kph, prompting Matt Renshaw to dead-bat the ball neatly into the covers.
26.2: Marco Jansen maintains the 133kph length just outside off, inviting Matt Renshaw to execute a soft push straight down the pitch.
26.3: Marco Jansen targets leg stump at 136kph as Matt Renshaw neatly tucks it away to the right of deep square leg.
26.4: Marco Jansen targets the channel on off, and Cameron Green meets it securely with a vertical blade.
26.5: Marco Jansen digs it in short down leg at 137ks, watching as Green adjusts slightly and leaves it through to the keeper.
26.6: Marco Jansen serves up a 137ks full delivery wide of off, and Green launches a commanding drive up and over extra cover with supreme authority.
44.6: Wiaan Mulder drops a one-twenty-five kph length ball outside off, allowing Matt Renshaw to whip it square onto the leg side for a single.
45.1: Marco Jansen delivers back of a length just outside off, meeting a high-elbowed block from Matt Renshaw.
45.2: Marco Jansen targets a good length just outside off, prompting Matt Renshaw to open the face and steer it past backward point for a sharp single.
45.3: Marco Jansen attacks with a sharp bumper that catches Cameron Green flush on the shoulder as he turns away.
45.4: Marco Jansen fires a one-thirty kph short ball down leg, which Cameron Green watches sail past after a shuffle across the crease.
45.5: Marco Jansen bangs it in at the body, and Cameron Green simply nudges it down into the leg-side grass.
45.6: Marco Jansen pins a one-thirty-four kph back-of-a-length delivery onto off stump, firmly blocked from the crease by Cameron Green.
46.1: Simon Harmer tosses one up just outside off, pushed wide of cover by Matt Renshaw for a brisk single.
46.2: Simon Harmer offers a slow, short ball outside off, punched away toward long-off by Cameron Green.
46.3: Simon Harmer floats a full delivery on off, prodded firmly toward the cover fielder by Matt Renshaw.
46.4: Simon Harmer floats it full on leg stump, allowing Matt Renshaw to unfurl a reverse sweep off the inner half racing out toward sweeper cover.
46.5: Simon Harmer floats it right up to the stumps and Matt Renshaw stays leg-side to drive it down to long-off for a single.
46.6: Simon Harmer drops it short outside off, allowing Cameron Green to cut it away toward Coetzee stationed at sweeper cover.
47.1: Marco Jansen delivers a good length ball at 135ks just outside off, which Cameron Green pushes firmly to the right of cover.
47.2: Marco Jansen bangs it in on a length at 135ks outside off stump, leaving Cameron Green to watch it sail through to the keeper.
47.3: Marco Jansen clocks 137ks on a length outside off, prompting a nimble hop from Cameron Green as he tucks it into the leg-side for a quick single.
47.4: Marco Jansen targets the fifth stump channel with a full 132ks delivery, met by a gentle off-side tap from Matt Renshaw.
47.5: Marco Jansen pitches it up, and Matt Renshaw works the ball away to deep mid-wicket for a comfortable single.
